samples.expectedText: One day, an accident happened because an aircraft was guided improperly by a marshaller when parking. The marshaller first guided the aircraft to a gate. When the aircraft was near the stop line, the marshaller gave a premature crossed wands signal which means stopping taxing, so the aircraft was stopped abruptly. The pilot set the parking brake and released the seatbelt sign. Unexpectedly, the marshaller showed the separated wands again and stopped them a little forward of the point. He did not give a clear signal, and the sudden stop caused fatigue and a medical emergency of 2 passengers. When the marshaller was asked about the signal, he said he did not give the signal. Anyway, it was not a good guidance but the final position of the aircraft was proper. Luckily there were no injuries on board.
